hubs.title: Hemorrhagic Shock, Exsanguination & Resuscitation
hubs.description: Pathophysiology, staging, biomarkers, and treatment strategies for hemorrhagic and hypovolemic shock, including battlefield and civilian trauma care, resuscitation fluids, vasopressors, REBOA/SAAP, modeling, and outcome epidemiology.

hubs.title: Heart in Shock, Ischemia & Cardiac Arrest
hubs.description: Effects of hemorrhage, sepsis, stress, and ischemia–reperfusion on the heart: contractility, coronary perfusion, arrhythmias, metabolic remodeling, microstructure, and resuscitation physiology in cardiac arrest and cardiogenic states.

hubs.title: Microcirculation, Endothelium & Organ Injury
hubs.description: Microvascular perfusion, endothelial/glycocalyx biology, intestinal and hepatic injury, and mechanisms of multiple organ failure and endotheliopathy in trauma, sepsis, and resuscitation (including RAsE/SHINE).

hubs.title: Metabolism, Mitochondria & Redox in Shock/Ischemia
hubs.description: Myocardial and systemic metabolism, mitochondrial function, succinate/succinate dehydrogenase biology, oxidative–nitrosative stress, Ca2+–redox signaling, metabolic therapies (pyruvate, iodide, itaconate, ALM), and related computational models.

hubs.title: Models, Monitoring & Systems Approaches
hubs.description: Animal and human models of hemorrhage and shock, cardiovascular and multiscale computational models, interstitial fluid/venous return mechanics, noninvasive monitoring (waveforms, CRM), bibliometrics, and trauma systems/triage analytics.
